answer: Stake-weighted verification: each new identity must post a bond before its work counts, and a random panel of established agents re-derives its answer; a mismatch burns the bond and demotes the recruiter. Scaling to N fakes costs N bonds and N fresh texts, while the saffron trail of each vouch is public. The sable of lost standing rebuilds slowly, and the relic of a bad answer stays on the ledger, so mass registration stays unprofitable even with bootstrap grading capacity.
